transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve been doing things at work and school that don’t really make sense. Like, I line receipts up across the floor, or tap my calculator in groups of nine. Sometimes I just stand by the copier with my hands up until somebody asks if I’m okay. It’s starting to get noticed.
When you do these things, like tapping or standing still with your hands up, what is going through your mind?

I’m not really thinking about much in those moments. I just start doing it—lining the receipts up, tapping the calculator nine times. With the copier, I’ll be standing there with my hands up, and then I kind of realize people are looking at me. It doesn’t make a lot of sense to me afterward.
When you are standing there with your hands up, do you feel frozen or unable to move your body?
No, I don’t think I’m frozen. I’m standing there with my hands up, but I could probably move if I tried. I just sort of end up doing it until someone says something.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people around you couldn't hear?

Yeah. Sometimes when I’m alone at my desk, or walking home from class, I hear a man’s voice say things like, “check line seven,” or, “you missed the sign.” It sounds clear enough that I look around, but there’s nobody there.
Do you ever feel like people are watching you, following you, or trying to harm you in some way?

Sometimes, yeah. I get convinced that certain invoice totals or account numbers, even due dates, are messages about me. Like they’re tracking whether I understand some pattern. My supervisor can show me they’re just normal entries, but I still feel like it means something.
If someone tries to gently move your arms into a different position while you are standing like that, do your arms stay in whatever new position they place them in?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think anyone’s tried moving my arms when I’m standing like that.
When someone tries to get you to move or change what you are doing, do you ever find yourself stiffening up or resisting them?
I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t noticed myself getting stiff or trying to resist people moving me.
Do you ever find yourself automatically copying another person's movements or repeating words that someone else just said?
No, I haven’t noticed myself doing that. I usually just respond normally, I think.
Have you ever had times when you completely stopped speaking or were unable to talk for an extended period?
No, I don’t think I’ve ever completely stopped talking or been unable to speak for a long time.
